changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The citable elements of a snapshot, in the order their text is written for a review (ADR 0165). Nothing writes them yet.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.team_element ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_element_id CHECK (element_id != ''), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_element_kind CHECK (kind ~ '[^[:space:]]'), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_element_parent CHECK (parent_element_id != element_id), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_element_text CHECK (octet_length(text) <= 2097152 AND position(chr(13) IN text) = 0), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_element_lines CHECK (first_line >= 1 AND last_line - first_line = char_length(text) - char_length(replace(text, chr(10), '')));

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The rules of an element, for every writer. It arrives only with its version, never changes, and leaves only when its version does.
changeSet.createProcedure: CREATE FUNCTION public.refuse_team_content_change() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'submitted team content never changes' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END $$

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The note that the submitter sends with a version (ADR 0165). It is context, never evidence. Nothing writes it yet.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.team_context ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_context_text CHECK (text ~ '[^[:space:]]' AND char_length(text) <= 10000);

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A note arrives only with its version and never changes. A version that ends loses its note with its other content.
